I am a graduate student in Applied Economics and Data Science at the University of Pennsylvania. I previously studied Economics at New York University, where I developed a strong interest in economics, data analysis, and business strategy. I have experience in market research, financial analysis, and data visualization, with technical skills in Excel, PowerPoint, R, Python, and Tableau. My career goal is to apply data-driven and economic insights to solve real-world business problems and pursue a career in data analytics, economic consulting, or business strategy.
